name: windows_fill
description: Clear and fill a text field with new value. Prefers Value pattern for reliability. Without a writable Value pattern it focuses the control and sends Ctrl+A, then Backspace or the new text; it refuses before any key when the control does not take keyboard focus. Reports Filled only when the control reads back the value.

handle.description: Optional window handle to validate against the element ref.

verifyFocus.description: Keyboard fallback only: require verified keyboard focus on the control before Ctrl+A (default true). Set false only for a control that never reports focus; the keys then go wherever focus is.
